text:
sasha: quick favor — can someone run a microbench comparing FlashAttention vs our paged-attn fused path? sequence=4096, batches=1,4,8. need p50/p95/p99 + throughput. also measure cold vs warm KV cache. i want this before tomorrow's perf sync.

liam: can do. which model binary/config? will run on p4-16 and p2-8.

sasha: use llama-13b-8k-quant (the q4f build in /opt/models/llama-13b/q4f). env flags: FLASH_PAGED=1, KERNEL_FUSE=1. please run with and without PAGE_BACKEND=1 to compare.

liam: got it. i'll run `nvprof` and collect nvtx ranges. quick command i plan to use: 
```
python -m bench.run 
  --model /opt/models/llama-13b/q4f 
  --seq 4096 
  --batch 4 
  --kernels flash,paged 
  --trials 60 
  --collect nvtx,allocs 
```
will also snapshot `/sys/kernel/mm/*` and `nvidia-smi -q` at start/end.

anya: heads-up — fyi i saw a longseq regression on a canary earlier (p50 up ~30%). might be related to a kernel reorder change from last week. attaching the short log: 
```
[canary-2025-11-02] model=llama-13b seq=4096 batch=1 p50=42.1ms p50-prev=31.7ms delta=+32%
KV warm hitrate=0.2
```

sasha: thanks, that matches the hypothesis. please run both cold/warm KV to confirm. also add a run with `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` to see if it's a launch timing issue.

liam: scheduling now. ETA ~30m for p2-8 run, will queue p4-16 after. tagging @perf-bot to create a run entry.

perf-bot: created perf run 2050012345-1: /runs/2050012345-1. assigned to liam. please upload traces to /perf/traces/2050012345/.

devops-jen: FYI canary window tomorrow 10:30-11:00 PST — please avoid destructive tests in that window. if you need reserved slots, DM me. :calendar:

liam: first run done (p2-8, batch=1). brief results: p50 flash=47.8ms, paged=39.2ms, p99 flash=92ms, paged=85ms. warm KV improved paged path by ~15%. attaching nvprof snapshot (uploaded).

anya: interesting — paged looks better for batch=1 but we still see variability on flash p99. can you run `--batch 8` and also try the old kernel stub (revert commit a1b2c3) to see if it regresses?

sasha: adding code review ping — PR #4567 touches kernel launch ordering. @anya @liam can you +1 a quick revert test if it reproduces?

liam: running batch=8 now. will include revert run afterwards.

perf-bot: run 2050012345-2 queued on p4-16 (batch=8). expected completion ~40m.

sasha: awesome — once we have both sets, i'll collate into the perf deck for tomorrow. if regressions hold, we'll open an incident checklist and pin rollback. thanks all :thumbsup:
